run_collect_results: run the script to collect DomainBed results from an input directory and generate a results file
run_collect_results_latex: run the script with --latex flag to generate a LaTeX formatted results.tex file from DomainBed records
run_collect_results_auto_lr: run the script with --auto_lr flag to use only the IIDAutoLRAccuracySelectionMethod for model selection
summarize_merge_records: summarize the merge_records function that groups and merges records by unique args dictionaries excluding holdout_fraction
review_format_mean: review the format_mean function that computes mean and standard error and returns formatted strings for latex or plain text
